run_log_regression_evaluation: run logistic regression evaluation on frozen DINOv3 features using the CLI entry point
run_benchmark_launcher: run the benchmark launcher to parse args, load a model, and execute log regression evaluation
train_logreg_model_for_C: train a logistic regression model with a given regularization C value on extracted features
sweep_C_values: sweep across 45 regularization C values to find the best hyperparameter on a validation set
create_logreg_module: create a LogRegModule wrapping scikit-learn LogisticRegression with optional OneVsRestClassifier for multi-label
